title: Observation stream, queue service and backpressure
summary: Observation distributes detached semantic state through a neutral stream/service with independent stream sequence, consumer checkpoints, leases/backpressure and Queue Fabric delivery.
invariants: Engine generation, observation stream sequence, Queue Fabric delivery identity and consumer checkpoint are different clocks/identities.
WLU-throttled Queue delivery must not delete or rewrite retained semantic observation history.
Consumer checkpoints are monotonic durable processing boundaries.
Subscriber congestion is an observer problem and must not stall the terminal/browser execution engine.
Queue Fabric remains transport authority; Observation does not become a message broker.
Observation producer/stream descriptors carry node identity, capability generation and proofRef without creating a separate trust system.

provenance.claim: Observation v0.5 defines Queue service, replay/checkpoints, WLU delivery separation, stable node identity, capability generation and proofRef.
